category_summary:
**Lead story — Bot Screen / Live Desktop Passthrough launch:** The week was dominated by the coordinated launch of **Bot Screen** for **Hermes Desktop**. **@NousResearch**'s [official announcement (streaming any bot's screen/session live)](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-ef6b4179c4fa) and **@Teknium**'s [launch post on interactive visual passthrough to the agent's machine](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-4784626f2a61) pulled the section's biggest engagement by far. An official **@tonbistudio** [walkthrough with docs link](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-d84a2bc0a85d), plus Teknium [amplifying the same guide video](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-d03d44ef66a9), gave newcomers an immediate on-ramp. Community sentiment was emphatically positive — ["Finallllly!"](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-014ad26a44c6) and ["Much needed!"](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-48968e1c836e) (204 likes, 20k views) suggest this was one of the most-requested Hermes capabilities to date.

**Ecosystem builds in the open — oh-my-hermes & Jev tooling:** **@rlaope** had a strong week: [open-sourcing **jeval** (evaluation + visual result extraction for **Jev**)](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-99948938337f) and [shipping **OMH+** updates to **oh-my-hermes** with **Jev skills**, plugins and aliases, **model routing**, and JEV-powered workflows](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-415aecf318f8) — positioning OMH as the [all-in-one plugin for AI-native **Hermes Agent** users](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-b4d141253a4f). A healthy signal of third-party tooling maturing around the agent.

**Official tips & responsive support:** **@NousResearch** highlighted a practical flex — [Hermes works over **iMessage** with any model of your choosing](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-768697783517). **@Teknium** [shipped a quick fix in response to user feedback](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-3e1742f36c0b) and [set clear bug-report etiquette in a cache dispute](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-d5a2f794eeec) (reproducible path or it didn't happen), while also [clarifying provenance in a multi-party thread](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-992950038a21): the discussed artifact was built by the Nous/Hermes team, not Anthropic.

**Community pulse:** Short-but-warm endorsements (["Impressive!"](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-015fe011793b), ["This is the way"](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-7fdb2254d801)) and celebratory emoji replies reinforce broadly positive sentiment centered on the launch. Curated out: duplicate **jeval**/OMH link drops, emoji-only replies, engagement-bait, and one [off-topic take on **Opus 5.5** vs **Claude Code**](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-797e0ee6c95e) that falls outside Hermes scope.

items.content:
You can now watch your agents work live as Hermes Desktop streams the screen of any bot's screen or session in real time. 

Watch it drive a browser, type into a terminal, or open a window. Take over anytime to interact with the Bot Screen or type credentials and seamlessly hand back off when you're done.
